records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Mateo,

Welcome to Wrenfield. There's no wrong way to start -- create a project, add a few tasks, invite people, and adjust as you figure out what works for your team.

Reply here if you need a hand.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

draft.subject: Picking up after our onboarding call
draft.body:
Hi Mateo,

Thanks for making time for the onboarding call last week. I wanted to follow up while things are still fresh.

Whenever you're ready, projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so a first project is usually the easiest place to start. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project if you'd like to go that route.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you and answer anything that came up afterwards.

Best,
Nadia
